name: smwpatches-cape-wall-and-spin-fly-fix
title: Cape Wall and Spin Fly Fix
description:
Fixes the glitch where you can cape spin while wall running, which in rare cases can cause unintended behaviour.

GHB edit: now also fixes a bug that the player can perform a cape spin while flying (which can "Turn around while flying"), since the hijack is located before the "perform cape spin" routine. Also converted to sa-1 hybrid.

If you only want one of these effect, just set one of the first two defines to zero. Setting both to zero will remove the patch from the ROM.
